content.description: Illustration showing SST tool being used to remove circlip from compressor shaft assembly

content.heading: REMOVE KEY
content.text: Using a hammer and punch, drive the key from the shaft.

content.description: Illustration showing hammer and punch being used to drive key from compressor shaft

content.heading: APPLY COMPRESSOR OIL TO INNER BORE
content.text: Apply compressor oil to the inner bore of the compressor.

content.description: Illustration showing oil being applied to inner bore of compressor assembly

substeps.text: Insert SST against the shaft. Then push the holder ring downward.

content.description: Illustration showing SST tool being inserted against shaft to push holder ring downward

content.text: Pull up the bar of the remover, and remove the shaft plate.

content.description: Illustration showing bar of remover being pulled up to remove shaft plate
